_comment: Model registry of the v2 uncertainty study (project 44). Panel decision of the project lead, 2026-10-08:
PANEL 2026-10-09 (user decision after the probes): haiku55, sonnet55, gpt6luna, gpt61sol, gem38flash, glm53flash. Reserves: everything else.
Anthropic family across three sizes (Haiku / Sonnet / Opus 5.5), GPT-6.1 sol (flex; replaced GPT-5.6 terra the
same evening), Gemini 3.8 Flash and two Chinese open-weight models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3). Of the former
as are terra, grok47, glm53, qwen38big and the 2026-10-08 additions gpt6luna, gpt6astra (probe only), glm53flash, mistrall4, hy4preview, step5preview, dsv4pro, qwen3827b.
Schema = src/memo45/models_45.json entries plus price_cache_read, price_cache_write, allow_fallbacks,
open_weights, in_panel, reasoning_levels, prices_fetched, price_endpoint, notes.
release: OpenRouter 'created' date (UTC), fetched 2026-10-08 from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models.
price_in / price_out / price_cache_read / price_cache_write: USD per 1e6 tokens, fetched 2026-10-08 from
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints for the endpoint named in price_endpoint (the one the
routing below reaches). Snapshot of all endpoints: results/meta/openrouter_endpoints_2026-10-08.json (+ _additions.json for the entries added the same evening).
price_cache_write null = the endpoint lists none. Used by src/estimate_icl_cost.py.
service_tier: 'flex' where OpenRouter exposes a flex endpoint (tag '<provider>/flex'); price_* are then the
flex prices (50 % of standard), as in the 45 registry. Anthropic and xAI expose no flex tier.
providers: provider.order sent to OpenRouter (provider slug or exact endpoint name; 'google-vertex/global' is the
STANDARD Vertex endpoint, its flex variant is 'google-vertex/global/flex'). Empty = default routing (only grok45
left; xAI is its sole host). Anthropic models are pinned to 'anthropic' (regional hosts bill 1.1x and would
split the prompt cache). allow_fallbacks: false for every
pinned entry (Common.jl::ask_gpt_full adds provider.allow_fallbacks=false, so a call fails instead of
silently landing on another host / quantisation / price), true where providers is empty.
reasoning: 'low' for every model = the main experiment's effort level (decision 2026-09-08), passed as
reasoning.effort; NOT a token budget.
reasoning_levels: null until measured by src/julia/Probe_Models.jl (effort-dosability probe). The probe
prints a suggested value; it is entered here by hand. OpenRouter lists reasoning_effort as supported for
every entry, but 45 showed several endpoints ignore it (Kimi K2.6, GLM 5/5.2, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek V4 Pro)
and some reject levels (Grok 4.5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash: HTTP 400 for 'none').
corpus: 'closed' = closed weights and data; 'weights' = open weights (open_weights = Hugging Face id), closed data.
in_panel: main panel of the ICL experiment (order of the entries = PANEL order). enabled: may be probed / run.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.notes: Panel (confirmed 2026-10-09). Pinned to Anthropic's own endpoint, no fallback: the regional hosts (google-vertex/us and /europe, azure/us, amazon-bedrock/us-east-1 and /eu-west-1) bill 1.1x, and spreading calls over several hosts splits the prompt cache. Long-context surcharge above 100k prompt tokens (0.50/2.50, cache read 0.05) -- the N=1000 training block stays below it (see estimate_icl_cost.py); check measured prompt_tokens.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.notes: Panel (confirmed 2026-10-09). Pinned to Anthropic's own endpoint, no fallback (regional hosts bill 1.1x; one host keeps the prompt cache together). No flex tier exists for Anthropic.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.notes: Pinned to Anthropic's own endpoint, no fallback (regional hosts bill 1.1x; one host keeps the prompt cache together). The anthropic/fast endpoint (2x price) is only reached on explicit request. Dropped from the panel 2026-10-09: Anthropic safety classifier refuses the ICL prompt from N>=250 (probe 2026-10-08).

models.name: GPT-6.1 sol
models.notes: Panel member since 2026-10-08 (evening), replaces terra (decision of the project lead). Flex endpoint openai/flex (served as openai/gpt-6.1-sol-20260929; 50 % of standard 2/10, cache read 0.05 vs 0.10). Long-context override above 272k prompt tokens (2/7.5 flex). At fetch time (2026-10-08 ~19 UTC) the flex endpoint reported status -5, uptime 0 % over the last 30 min and 62 % over the last day -- with allow_fallbacks false a call fails rather than landing on the standard (2x) endpoint; flex can also be slow (minutes per call), timeout 900 s.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.notes: Panel (confirmed 2026-10-09). Pinned to Google AI Studio with service_tier flex -> endpoint google-ai-studio/flex (50 % of standard 0.75/3.75). 'google-vertex/global' is the exact name of the STANDARD Vertex endpoint (the flex one is 'google-vertex/global/flex'), so it is not in the order. Probe_Models.jl's cost_ratio shows whether flex was actually billed. price_cache_write is OpenRouter's Gemini cache-write figure, passed through as listed. Implicit caching supported.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.notes: DeepSeek's own endpoint. TIME-OF-DAY PRICING: weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC are billed at 2x (0.30/1.20, cache read 0.006); the prices here are the off-peak / weekend base. Schedule runs outside those windows. Implicit caching supported. Dropped from the panel 2026-10-09: blocked by the OpenRouter account privacy setting/guardrail (paid-prompt training).

models.name: Kimi K3
models.notes: Moonshot's own endpoint (moonshotai/mxfp4). Cheaper third-party fp4 hosts exist but are excluded (quantisation drift). OpenRouter lists supports_implicit_caching=false for this endpoint: whether the cache-read price is ever reached must be measured (cached_tokens). Dropped from the panel 2026-10-09: too expensive for its accuracy (projected $69/$206 main run at R=1/R=3).

models.name: GPT-5.6 terra
models.notes: Reserve since 2026-10-08 (evening): replaced in the panel by gpt61sol (decision of the project lead). Flex endpoint openai/flex (50 % of standard 2/12). Long-context override above 272k prompt tokens. Rejects temperature/top_p other than 1 (omitted).

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Reserve; v2 panel member until 2026-10-08. Pinned to Anthropic's own endpoint, no fallback. ESOL-contaminated (45: 62 % verbatim).

models.name: GPT-5.6 sol
models.notes: Reserve; v2 panel member until 2026-10-08. Flex prices (standard 2/10). The 45 registry listed 2.50/15 flex on 2026-07-26 -- the price has since dropped.

models.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.notes: Reserve; v2 panel member until 2026-10-08. Order names the flex endpoint itself ('google-vertex/global' alone is the STANDARD endpoint). Flex prices (standard 0.75/3.75; the 45 registry recorded 0.75/3.75 as its flex price on 2026-07-26 with order ['google-vertex/global'] -- possibly flex was never applied there; check cost_ratio in the probe). 45: rejected reasoning=none.

models.name: Grok 4.5
models.notes: Reserve; v2 panel member until 2026-10-08. HTTP 400 for reasoning=none (45, 2026-07-26). Long-context override above 200k prompt tokens.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.notes: Reserve. xAI offers priority only (no flex). Long-context override above 200k prompt tokens.

models.name: GLM 5.3
models.notes: Reserve. Z.ai's own endpoint (z-ai/fp8). GLM 5 / 5.2 ignored the reasoning budget in 45.

models.name: Qwen3.8 2.4T-A95B
models.notes: Reserve. Alibaba's own endpoint; it lists a cache-write price (2.50) that the other hosts do not. Qwen3.5 ignored the reasoning budget in 45.

models.name: GPT-6 luna
models.notes: Panel since 2026-10-09 (added 2026-10-08 as reserve). Flex endpoint openai/flex (served as openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922; standard 0.10/0.50). Long-context override above 272k prompt tokens.

models.name: GPT-6 astra
models.notes: Panel member since 2026-10-13 (user decision: stronger LLM, R=3). Reserve (added 2026-10-08). PROBE ONLY -- too expensive for the main run. Flex endpoint openai/flex (served as openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903; standard 10/50). Long-context override above 272k prompt tokens.

models.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
models.notes: Panel since 2026-10-09 (added 2026-10-08 as reserve). Z.ai's own endpoint (z-ai/fp8); cheaper third-party fp4/fp8 hosts excluded (quantisation drift). GLM 5 / 5.2 ignored the reasoning budget in 45.

models.name: Mistral Large 4
models.notes: Reserve (added 2026-10-08). Mistral's own endpoint (the only host). The endpoint lists discount 0.5: the price 0.68/2.09 is a launch discount and may double when it ends -- re-check before a main run.

models.name: Hy4 preview
models.notes: Reserve (added 2026-10-08). Tencent's own endpoint (tencent/fp8). Listed 0.7506/2.2509 (cache read 0.0378) is the 16:00-24:00 UTC price; 00:00-16:00 UTC it is 0.834/2.501 (cache read 0.042), i.e. 1.11x. Preview model.

models.name: Step 5 Preview
models.notes: Reserve (added 2026-10-08, released the same day). StepFun's own endpoint (stepfun/fp8, the only host). No open weights listed on OpenRouter. Preview model.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
models.notes: Reserve (added 2026-10-08). DeepSeek's own endpoint. TIME-OF-DAY PRICING: weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC billed at 2x (1.32/3.96, cache read 0.044); prices here are the off-peak / weekend base. DeepSeek V4 Pro ignored the reasoning budget in 45. Implicit caching supported.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.notes: Reserve (added 2026-10-08). Alibaba's own endpoint (lists 0.425 in, i.e. 0.42 rounded; cache write 0.53125). Qwen3.5 ignored the reasoning budget in 45.

models.name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro
models.notes: Xiaomi flagship, >1T params, open weights. OpenRouter lists `reasoning` but NOT `reasoning_effort` on any endpoint (2026-10-09) -> effort levels may be ignored; probe required. Added 2026-10-09 on user request.

models.name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash
models.notes: Xiaomi MoE 309B/15B active, open weights. No `reasoning_effort` listed (2026-10-09); probe required. Added 2026-10-09.
